useFor: Use the default circle shape for people, identities and agent portraits, including in rails and lists: size sm in a 38px row. Use shape="square" only when an explicit square variation is requested. Always give an AvatarFallback with the first initial. AvatarBadge marks a live agent; AvatarGroup shows who shares a mailbox.
